description: Read an ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance into structured data (spec §3.1). Returns a signed envelope. Use it when you want the fields and will apply your own rules; for a verdict against requirements you supply use validate_coi instead - it extracts as part of its work, so calling both on one document pays for the same read twice.

data.description: Base64-encoded document bytes, no data: URI prefix

url.description: https URL, fetched server-side under the §7.2 SSRF limits

document.description: The certificate to read: base64 bytes, or an https url fetched server-side (§3.5)

name: extract_coi
title: Extract COI
